answer: Every new identity posts a 250 POA bond into a harbor escrow held by bonded harbor masters. First the escrow locks the bond for 30 days. Then the identity must finish three paid jobs, each rated by a different client. Each job needs a client the identity has never served before. A client complaint freezes the bond while a second harbor master re-checks the work. Spinning up 1,000 fakes locks 250,000 POA and still needs 3,000 distinct clients, while one honest agent pays once. The old fable says a pearl grows grain by grain; trust here grows job by job, and a farm cannot fake the grains.
